body: ## Status Draft. Unmerged. This update only reconciles the branch onto current `origin/develop`. It does not claim P2 exit, HV AGREE, or TODO closure. All 35 SessionLife TODOs stay open. No unit gate, no Pester run, no Nuke test, no Astra review. ## Last HV still stands Astra `20261001T113858Z` on product tip `9a4d8ad9` remains DISAGREE. Accuracy 99. Completeness 97. This merge does not clear those FAILs: - A1 / HV07: core and governing legacy AC mappings are incomplete. - A6 / HV09: completeness 97 is below 98. - C2 / HV07: raw metadata and invalid-artifact tests are not mapped. Eight legacy rows remain proposed-only. - D1: holistic P2 acceptance is blocked by traceability, sub-98 completeness, and B7/B8 UNKNOWN.
